posts.name: deanjday
posts.cooked:
I am about to start a campaign based on the starter pack and two free adventures already released. My question is does anyone have any reasonable time frame for the book to be released to the general public?

I see that the game has missed a lot of release time frames over the years, so it makes me nervous starting a campaign for a game that has yet to have its full rules released.

should i hold off till release? should I just use another system? or am i worrying for no reason and the game will be released soon?

posts.name: drezzinator
posts.cooked:
I second what Sea-Envy said, you should be able to get it by late January. Printing is done and GTG are starting to get shipments and theyll be shipping those out over the next couple of weeks to KS backers.

Depending on what your campaign is like, I'd reccomend waiting since we're at the home stretch. That way you'll have the full rules of character creation and moderating the game. Personally character creation is what gets me jazzed to see what my players come up with and adapt my campaign accordingly.
